# djust

> djust is a Python/Rust framework that brings Phoenix LiveView-style reactive server-side rendering to Django. Real-time UI updates over WebSockets with ~58 KB gzipped client JS, zero build step, and Rust-powered VDOM diffing + template rendering (roughly 7-11x faster than Django on variable- and filter-heavy templates; see the README's Performance section for the measured table and the benchmark script).

## Application conventions for AI agents

Read [Application engineering conventions](https://github.com/djust-org/djust/blob/main/docs/ai/conventions.md)
and the [focused AI reference](https://github.com/djust-org/djust/tree/main/docs/ai).
Use documentation matching the installed release; main may describe newer APIs.

## Docs

- [Getting Started](https://djust.org/docs/getting-started/): Installation, setup, and your first LiveView
- [Core Concepts](https://djust.org/docs/core-concepts/): LiveView lifecycle, mount/render cycle, event handling
- [Components](https://djust.org/docs/components/): LiveComponent, stateful and stateless components
- [State Management](https://djust.org/docs/state/): Decorators (@debounce, @throttle, @cache and DraftModeMixin are wired; @optimistic and @client_state are inert markers — #2699, #2680)
- [Forms](https://djust.org/docs/forms/): FormMixin, real-time validation, form handling patterns
- [Testing](https://djust.org/docs/testing/): LiveViewTestClient, SnapshotTestMixin, LiveViewSmokeTest
- [API Reference](https://djust.org/docs/api/): Full API documentation
- [Features](https://djust.org/features/): Feature overview and capabilities
- [Security](https://djust.org/security/): Security model, CSRF, authorization patterns
- [Examples](https://djust.org/examples/): Interactive code examples
- [Benchmarks](https://djust.org/benchmarks/): Performance comparisons
- [FAQ](https://djust.org/faq/): Common questions and answers
